name: PEFT
summary: Hugging Face Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning library (LoRA and related methods) for adapting large models without full fine-tuning.
description: Established Apache-2.0 library (huggingface/peft; not archived; not a 2026 launch). PyPI peft 0.21.2 verified 2026-11-11; docs https://huggingface.co/docs/peft/index verified 2026-11-12 (https://huggingface.co/docs/peft redirects there). Install with pip install peft. Commonly paired with transformers and TRL. Model licenses, checkpoints and compute are separate.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package: pip install peft.
